name: Alter Route Title
description: Lets you alter the page (route) title for specific routes.
project_description:
Alter Route Title 

 The Alter Route Title module enables you to modify the titles of existing routes in Drupal. This module specifically handles routes provided by contributed and custom modules. It seamlessly integrates with Drupal's `_title_callback` functionality, ensuring that the core title callback logic for dynamic titles remains intact. Additionally, the module supports the export and import of Alter Route Title configurations, allowing easy transfer of settings.

 Installation 

 Follow the official [Drupal Module Installation Guide]( https://www.drupal.org/docs/extending-drupal/installing-modules ) for step-by-step instructions.

 Usage 

 1. Navigate to:

 Administration >> Configuration >> System >> Alter Route Title

 2. In the displayed table, you will find a list of available routes along with their current titles.

 3. Add or update custom titles directly in the table to modify route titles as needed.
